memories.text: Home is Zurich for now, a flat in Wiedikon, and I pay far too much for a balcony the size of a towel.
I price mortgage risk at Alpenbank, and the coffee machine is the best part of the office.
I'm an actuary by training, which means I'm the person who ruins dinner parties with probabilities.
A glass of Pinot Noir with dinner is my little ritual, and I've got a small cellar going.
Show me the formulas, not just the results, otherwise I don't trust the numbers.
Got tested after a picnic scare and I'm not allergic to wasp stings, it was just a nasty one.
My brother Lukas lives in Basel and we meet halfway for hikes.
The reserving committee sits on the first Monday of each month.
Quarterly reserving review: pull the claims triangle, run chain-ladder, compare with last quarter, and flag any movement above five percent.
I'm on Meridian, a project to rebuild our flood pricing model from scratch.
Meridian is in model validation, which mostly means arguing about assumptions.
I joined the Limmat Swim Club for the open-water season, cold but addictive.
Spent Ascension weekend hiking in Ticino, and the lakes were impossibly blue.
Sesame is my big no, I'm allergic to sesame so I read every label.
Proper rösti: boil the potatoes the day before, grate them cold, and fry in butter for fifteen minutes per side.
Correction, the reserving committee now meets on the second Tuesday instead.
My brother's stag weekend is planned for Prague in late summer.
Meridian is owned by Ostwind Reinsurance, we just build it for them.
Meridian is stuck answering a long list of questions from the regulator.
Got tickets to a premiere at the Zurich Film Festival and stood next to a famous director.
The stag weekend moved from Prague to Budapest because of the thermal baths.
Our tomcat brought a live mouse into the kitchen at 3am yesterday.
I don't own a car; trams and trains do the job perfectly well here.
Remind me to cancel the Swiss health insurance before the end of March.
We moved to Vienna in May, and the coffee houses are already ruining my productivity.
Starting in May I lead the pricing team at Danube Insurance.
Danube Insurance is headquartered in Linz, so I take the train there twice a month.
My new boss is Marta Novak, our chief actuary, sharp and very patient.
Marta lives in Bratislava and commutes in on the early train.
I started studying for the final actuarial fellowship exam in November.
I've cut out wine completely and switched to alcohol-free beer with dinner.
Meridian was approved by the regulator last week, champagne all round, well, alcohol-free for me.
Just back from a week in Sicily, mostly eating arancini and climbing Etna.
I passed the final fellowship exam, so I'm officially a fully qualified actuary.
Developing black-and-white film: eight minutes in developer, a one-minute stop bath, five minutes of fixer, then rinse for ten.
I've never been to Africa, and Morocco keeps coming up as a first trip.
Film photography is my weekend obsession, I shoot mostly on an old Leica.
Remind me to buy the motorway vignette before the trip in December.
